title: meristem
description: A region of undifferentiated, actively dividing cells — the generative origin of plant form. Persistent (indefinitely active) and indeterminate: a metastable field of potential whose differentiation is resolved by hormone gradients and environmental signal. All differentiated tissues and organs derive from it. Generated by the plant's dividing.

undifferentiated.description: cells not yet committed to any tissue fate

persistent.description: remains active indefinitely — growth is never finished

generative.description: all differentiated tissues and organs ultimately derive from it
